Messrs [Harper](organizations/other_248.qmd)

Gentlemen

I am much obliged for your [remittance](organizations/other_172.qmd) of [£5](organizations/other_160.qmd) for [Stray Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_170.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge
